tasks.summary: Implemented optional userUuid validation and LEFT JOIN entitlement checks for episode playback. Anonymous free playback remains available; paid playback without a matching entitlement returns EPISODE_ACCESS_DENIED (403). Updated Postman coverage and API docs. Verified localhost:3000 reflected the changes. npm --prefix back run lint, npm --prefix back run test (68 unit tests and 51 API requests passed), and npm --prefix back run build all passed.
